label: D2 RUNG-COMPRESSION CELL: two deck-paired cells on ONE band and the SAME 200 decks. CELL R800 = frozen fair PIMC probe (k4x688=2752, tie-arbiter OFF) vs HeuristicMCTS(h800, c=3.0); CELL R1600 = the identical probe vs HeuristicMCTS(h1600, c=3.0). The two invocations differ in EXACTLY ONE experimental argument, --rung-sims. PRIMARY = deck-paired S = M_R800 - M_R1600 in pts/game with its z, testing whether the ladder's h800->h1600 spacing is a usable, non-compressed unit at this rung.
notes: NOT YET CLAIMED -- this row is DRAFTED for the orchestrator to append verbatim (see _csv_row below) once the pair is blind-committed and owner-authorized (DESIGN.md §0). Seeds 141000000000..141000000199 (200 decks x 2 seatings = 400 games PER CELL, 800 games total; ONE deck set shared by both cells). CRN across the two cells is DELIBERATE and the primary statistic is the deck-paired difference of margins S = M_R800 - M_R1600, not either cell's absolute reading alone. This band is NOT to be pooled with any other band (CL-068: measured 1.8-2.2x cross-band over-dispersion on comparable contrasts) -- the only robust statistic here is the within-band deck-paired S. The DESIGN §9 pilot uses a DISJOINT throwaway seed range, 141999999000..141999999007 (8 decks, CELL R800 config only), which is discarded and never pooled with this band and is never itself claimed as a row. Stated prior, recorded before game 1: two prior readings of the nominal h800->h1600 spacing disagree by 2.8x -- CL-023 (measurement/level2/LEVEL2_LADDER_VERDICT.md, +55.2 +/- 17.6 elo, paired z 3.23, band 3.0e9+) vs experiments/results.csv row l22_ctrl_heur1600_vs_heur800_b310_n400 (+20.0 elo, sigma 17.4, z 3.285, band 3.10e9). This band's purpose is to resolve that contradiction within one band, deck-paired, at a fixed knob set (both rungs at UCT c=3.0 -- DESIGN §2 shows there was never a c=1.5 rung to begin with, so no exploration-constant arm is carried on this band). Once this row is appended for real, band identity is load-bearing per CLAUDE.md and this band retires from confirmatory use once it has influenced a decision, per the standing BAND_REGISTRY.csv convention.
